subject: English
title: Back to Green
subtitle: Ril the little parrot
hero_picture: A green mother parrot and three little green parrots on a branch of a big tree in a green forest.

sections.heading: Polly waits
text: Polly the parrot is waiting for her chicks.
Her friends the elephant and the rabbit come to see.
sections.caption: Polly waits
sections.picture: A green mother parrot sitting on three white eggs in a nest, an elephant and rabbit looking up.

sections.heading: One, two, three
text: The first little parrot comes out.
The second comes out next. The third comes out too.
sections.caption: One, two, three
sections.picture: Three baby parrots hatching from cracked eggshells.

sections.heading: Jil, Dil and Ril
text: 'I am Jil.' 'I am Dil.' 'My name is Ril.'
Jil has a big beak. Dil has long legs. Ril has a red ring.
Jil, Dil and Ril fly up in the sky.
sections.caption: Jil, Dil and Ril
sections.picture: Three young green parrots flying together in a blue sky over trees.

sections.heading: Ril turns red
text: Ril flies away and falls into a tin.
There is red paint in it. Ouch!
Ril was green. Now he is red. 'No, Ril is green!'
sections.caption: Ril turns red
sections.picture: A small parrot covered in red paint climbing out of a blue paint tin near a house.

sections.heading: Green again
text: Ril is sad. He walks away.
It started raining. The rain washed the paint.
'Hurrah! I am green again.' All are happy.
sections.caption: Green again
sections.picture: A happy green parrot flying in the rain near his parrot friends on a branch.

activity: Draw three parrots. Give one a big beak, one long legs and one a red ring.
talk: How many chicks did Polly have?
How did Ril become green again?
summary: Ril the parrot fell into red paint; the rain washed it away and he was green again.

questions.prompt: How many little parrots came out?
questions.explanation: Jil, Dil and Ril: three parrots.

questions.prompt: Ril fell into a tin of...
questions.explanation: There was red paint in the tin.
It started raining and Ril became green.
